title: juncus arcticus var. balticus
intro: Juncus arcticus var. balticus, commonly known as Baltic rush or northern jointed rush, is a type of plant that belongs to the Juncaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Baltic rush include soothing and calming effects on the skin and mucous membranes, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Juncus arcticus var. balticus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
